summary: Fixed term that rolls month-to-month with 10-day termination notice. Known rule gap: the periodic rule skips fixed-term leases.

findings.quote: During any month-to-month renewal period, either party may terminate the tenancy by giving the other party at least 10 days' written notice.

nearMisses.quote: Unless either party gives written notice of non-renewal at least 30 days before the end of the initial term
